title: Inventory Receiving, Explicit Lineage, Quality and Allocation Operator Workflow
scope: Bounded pilot inventory operator boundary over the existing SW0 inventory, demand and explicit-lineage kernels after SW1-04A remediation.
claims: inventory receive, quality, transform, derived-receive and allocation actions require real Authority grants with quantity context where applicable
allocation authority is scoped to the affected lot rather than a caller-controlled allocation identifier
custody is not inferred from UI role; the receiving operator must match the declared custodian in this pilot workflow
allocation resolves the purchase obligation from the canonical demand ledger rather than trusting caller-shaped obligation state
transform consumption reduces source allocatable availability so transformed and source quantities cannot be double allocated
derived lots must match explicit output lineage quantity
unsafe or not-yet-accepted lots report zero allocatable availability
future-dated quality evidence cannot unlock inventory early
receipt/lineage collision is prevalidated so failure cannot leave a ghost inventory receipt
lot and obligation over-allocation fail closed
limitations: reference workflow remains in-memory in this SW1 product slice; durable lineage and transactional primitives already exist from SW0
SW1-05 does not independently prove stale-command/version fencing and therefore does not add new INV-028 proof
no production warehouse UI or device integration
next: SW1-06 pick/pack/pickup, acceptance and exception workflow
